questions.skill: 区分司法结论与立法背景
questions.q: A court allows city inspectors to check permit status while coordinating with national officers. The opinion cites a statute encouraging shared databases and joint inspections. Which statement is the court's conclusion rather than the supporting reason?
o: The legislature encouraged coordination between national and local officials.
Local inspectors may play a legitimate role within the enforcement system.
Officials are encouraged to share information.
National law no longer applies to local inspections.

exp.trans: 法院允许城市检查员在与国家执法人员协调时核查许可证状态。判决援引了一项鼓励共享数据库和联合检查的法律。法院的结论是：地方检查员可以在执法体系中发挥正当作用。
exp.structure: The court allows...陈述法院允许的行为；The opinion cites...介绍支撑理由的法律背景。问题要求找conclusion，因此应回到法院实际允许什么。
exp.other: coordinate 协调；permit status 许可证状态；cite 引用；supporting reason 支持理由。
exp.meaning: 文章中的立法背景、理由和司法结论承担不同功能。即使理由出现得更显眼，也不能把它当成题干询问的结论。
exp.rest: 鼓励协调和共享信息都是支持理由；原文并未取消国家法律对地方检查的约束。

questions.target: subject A to B / be subjected to
questions.skill: be subject to / be subjected to
questions.q:
The cleaner deliberately subjected the curtains to a steam treatment yesterday.
要保留“昨天实际施加了处理”的含义，哪句被动改写准确？
o: The curtains are subject to changes in fashion.
The curtains were exempt from treatment yesterday.
The curtains were subjected to steam yesterday.
The curtains are suitable for steam treatment.

exp.trans: 清洁人员昨天特意对窗帘做了蒸汽处理。选项中的被动改写为：窗帘昨天受了蒸汽处理。
exp.structure: 原主干The cleaner + subjected + the curtains + to a steam treatment。被动改写将the curtains作主语，were subjected是一般过去时被动谓语，to steam说明处理内容，yesterday保留时间；施事已经明确时可省略by the cleaner。这里不是系表结构。
exp.other: cleaner 清洁人员；curtain 窗帘；deliberately 特意地；steam treatment 蒸汽处理。
exp.meaning: were subjected to steam表示窗帘昨天实际经历了蒸汽处理；关键是事件性的被动谓语，不是可能受影响或适合处理的状态。
exp.rest: are subject to changes in fashion：说窗帘可能受时尚变化影响，不是昨天被处理的事件。were exempt from treatment：免于处理，与原文相反。are suitable for steam treatment：适合做处理，只表示适宜性，不能证明处理发生过。

questions.target: 总结范围 / 后续核验
questions.q: After presenting a commuter survey, a paragraph says: “To sum up, the new schedule suits many commuters. The council will review it after winter, when school travel patterns change.” What do these lines support?
o: The winter review has already overturned the survey findings.
The council has changed the discussion to the cost of new buses.
The paragraph summarises current findings and identifies a later check.
The survey has measured how school journeys changed during the coming winter.

exp.trans: 在呈现通勤调查后，一段写道：“总的说来，新时刻表适合许多通勤者。委员会将在冬季之后重新评估它，届时学生出行规律会变化。”这些句子总结当前发现，并提出之后的核验。
exp.structure: To sum up引入对已给调查的概括。The new schedule + suits + many commuters。The council + will review + it表达将来的评估；when从句补充冬后出行规律变化。
exp.other: commuter 通勤者；schedule 时刻表；review 重新评估；travel pattern 出行规律。
exp.meaning: 总结当前部分与计划未来检查可以同段共存；未来检查还未发生。单靠总结词或后续计划，不能保证这一段必为全文末段或必有下一段。
exp.rest: already overturned把未来复核改成已完成的推翻；cost of new buses凭空替换主题；has measured ... coming winter把尚未来到的时期说成已取得观测结果。

questions.q:
The plumber thanked the neighbour. He had borrowed a ladder from the neighbour.
哪句合并正确？
o: The plumber thanked the neighbour from that he had borrowed a ladder.
The plumber thanked the neighbour whom from he had borrowed a ladder.
The plumber thanked the neighbour from whom he had borrowed a ladder.
The plumber thanked the neighbour whom he had borrowed a ladder from him.

exp.trans: 水管工感谢了那位借梯子给他的邻居。
exp.structure: 原始简单句：He had borrowed a ladder from the neighbour. → 用whom替代重复的the neighbour：the neighbour whom he had borrowed a ladder from → 把from前置：the neighbour from whom he had borrowed a ladder。外层主干是The plumber + thanked + the neighbour，后接修饰neighbour的定语从句。
exp.other: plumber 水管工；neighbour 邻居；ladder 梯子；borrow A from B 从B那里借来A。
exp.meaning: from不是临时猜出来的，来自原句borrow...from...；先行词是人，介词后用whom。
exp.rest: from that：关系代词that不能直接置于介词后。whom from he：介词前置时必须是from whom，不是whom from。from him：关系代词whom已经代替该人，再保留him造成重复。

questions.target: imagined that ... had not / 提取完整观点
questions.skill: 信念内容不能由后续结果倒推
questions.q: Noor imagined that a software update had not changed her machine's output. Later measurements showed a substantial change. Which statement describes Noor's initial belief?
o: She initially thought the update made no difference.
She had decided to replace the machine entirely.
She knew from the beginning that output had changed greatly.
She was excessively enthusiastic about software updates.

exp.trans: Noor起初认为更新没有改变机器产出，后来的测量才发现变化明显。
exp.structure: Noor imagined that...中that从句作宾语；had not changed是其核心否定谓语；Later measurements引出相反事实。
exp.other: output 产出；substantial 显著的；measurement 测量；initial 初始的。
exp.meaning: 必须区分人物当时相信什么与后来实际发现了什么；不能只因出现update就推定其对软件痴迷。
exp.rest: 更换机器无依据；把后来证据当成最初已知事实颠倒时间；过分热衷更新是附加心理描述。

questions.q: The redesign owes its success not to a faster motor but to a simpler control panel. Which reading keeps the shared relation intact?
o: The faster motor owes its success to the control panel.
Success is credited to the panel rather than to the motor.
The simpler panel was made possible by the redesign's earlier success.
The sentence credits the motor and the panel equally.

exp.trans: 这次重新设计的成功不是由于更快的电机，而是由于更简单的控制面板。两个to短语共同说明同一个成功应归因于什么。
exp.structure: The redesign是主语，owes是谓语，its success是宾语。not to a faster motor和but to a simpler control panel是同层并列的归因补足语，都受owes its success支配。
exp.other: redesign 重新设计；owe A to B 把A归因于B；motor 电机；control panel 控制面板。
exp.meaning: 共享的是owe success to...的归因结构，不是让后半句生成新主语或改变成功的所属对象。not...but...排除电机、强调面板。
exp.rest: The faster motor owes...把电机改成主语并换掉success所属对象；panel was made possible...把面板作为成功的结果，反转因果；equally忽略not对电机解释的排除。

questions.skill: 包裹与打结的动作区别
questions.q: Before shipping a glass instrument, a clerk covered it with protective cloth, folding the cloth around the case in several layers. No knot or fastening was used. Which paraphrase best describes the action?
o: wrapped the case in protective cloth
tied the cloth tightly around the case
passed the cloth to a colleague nearby
lit the cloth with a match

exp.trans: 发运玻璃仪器前，工作人员用防护布包住仪器，把布一层层折叠在外壳周围；没有打结或固定。动作是包裹。
exp.structure: a clerk covered it...是主干；folding the cloth around the case补充包裹方式；No knot or fastening was used排除了打结固定。
exp.other: protective cloth防护布；case外壳；layer层；fastening固定件/固定动作。
exp.meaning: wrap强调用材料包住或缠绕物体；tie强调用绳带系住，常包含打结或固定。此处布料覆盖并折叠，没有系结。
exp.rest: tie要求系住/固定的动作，题干明确说没有knot或fastening；pass表示传递；light表示点燃，均不符合包裹仪器的场景。

questions.skill: 作者立场 + do so 回指
questions.q: A transport ministry says that because it does not want to carry out Parliament's rail-safety plan, local councils should not be allowed to enforce it either. The court rejects this claim. What is best supported?
o: The court checks an executive attempt to extend power over local councils.
Parliament alone must enforce every rail-safety rule across all regions.
The ministry has unlimited control over local councils and their rules.
Local councils may ignore national rail-safety laws whenever they choose to do so.

exp.trans: 法院正在制衡行政部门试图扩大自身对地方议会的权力。
exp.structure: because引出交通部不愿执行议会计划的原因；should not be allowed...either表示它还想阻止地方执行；The court rejects this claim给出司法回应。
exp.other: carry out 执行；executive 行政部门；council 地方议会；reject a claim 驳回一种主张。
exp.meaning: 行政部门不愿执行议会的计划，不等于它可以阻止地方在法律允许范围内执行。法院驳回这种主张，体现对行政权的制衡。
exp.rest: 原文没有说所有铁路安全规则只能由议会执行；交通部并没有无限控制权；法院驳回行政部门的主张也不意味着地方可以无视所有国家法律。

text4-agreement-target.skill: 区分法官认可的结论与国会提供的理由
text4-agreement-target.q: A court permits county officers to check residency status during limited enforcement encounters. It cites Congress's support for joint national-local enforcement. What did the judges agree on?
o: Congress must personally direct every local enforcement decision.
Local authorities may assist with enforcement within the limits set by law.
National officers must withhold all enforcement information from local teams.
Local authorities can disregard national rules when enforcing local policy.

exp.trans: 法院允许县级执法人员在有限的执法接触中核查居住身份，并引用国会支持国家与地方共同执法的立场。法官达成一致的是：地方当局可以在法律规定的范围内协助执法。
exp.structure: A court permits...直接陈述司法结论；It cites...引出支持这一结论的立法背景。题目问What did the judges agree on，因此应回答法院允许什么，而不是重复国会的理由。
exp.other: permit 允许；residency status 居住身份；joint 共同的；enforcement 执法；withhold information 不提供信息。
exp.meaning: 阅读题要区分结论和论据。国会鼓励共同执法，是法院认可地方执法角色的理由，不是题目所问的结论本身。
exp.rest: 国会亲自指挥每项地方执法决定过于绝对；原文鼓励信息共享而非要求扣留信息；地方参与执法并不意味着可以无视国家规则。

text4-agreement-target.target: what judges upheld vs legislative justification
text4-agreement-target.skill: 判断题干询问的是司法结论还是解释理由
text4-agreement-target.q: A court upheld municipal inspectors' limited role in checking flood barriers. In support, it cited a law inviting national and municipal teams to share inspection reports. What did the court uphold?
o: National lawmakers were required to lead each municipal inspection.
City inspectors could assist while complying with national rules.
Municipal teams gained the right to replace national flood standards.
National inspectors had to stop exchanging reports with city teams.

exp.trans: 法院认可市政检查员在防洪设施检查中的有限作用，并援引鼓励国家和地方机构共享检查报告的法律作为依据。问题问法院认可的结论，而不是法律提供的支持理由。
exp.structure: A court upheld是第一句核心司法结论；In support, it cited...是第二句介绍支持证据的结构。What did the court uphold要求回到第一句。
exp.other: uphold 维持、认可；municipal 市政的；barrier 防洪设施；cite 引用；inspection 检查；comply with 遵守。
exp.meaning: 法院认可地方机构在法律约束下协助检查；国会的协作规定只是理由。不能把原因中的立法机关错认成法院同意的具体事项。
exp.rest: 立法机关亲自检查不是结论；市政机构没有权力替换国家标准；原文支持共享报告，不能推成停止共享。

text4-agreement-target.target: what the judges agreed on vs why
text4-agreement-target.skill: 题干询问对象 + 结论与理由分层
text4-agreement-target.q: Judges agreed that county officers could verify residency status during certain enforcement encounters. The opinion explains that the national legislature had repeatedly encouraged joint national-local enforcement and information sharing. What did the judges agree on?
o: The national legislature had taken over every local enforcement decision.
Counties were independent of national law.
Local authorities had a legitimate role in enforcement within legal limits.
National officers were required to withhold information.

exp.trans: 法官们同意，县级执法人员在某些执法接触中可以核查居住身份。判决解释说，国家立法机关一直鼓励国家与地方共同执法和共享信息。法官们达成一致的是：地方当局在法律允许的范围内拥有正当的执法角色。
exp.structure: Judges agreed that...直接引出法官认可的结论；The opinion explains that...再引出支持这一结论的理由。不要把后一句的national legislature误当成题干询问的结论主体。
exp.other: verify 核实；enforcement 执法；legitimate 正当的、合法的；withhold information 扣留信息、不提供信息。
exp.meaning: 题干问what did the judges agree on，先找法院允许什么，再看立法机关的政策如何解释该决定。理由提到了国会，不代表答案就是国会介入。
exp.rest: 没有说立法机关接管所有地方执法；地方仍受国家法律约束；原文支持信息共享，而非要求联邦人员隐瞒信息。

subject.target: be subject to / be subjected to
subject.skill: be subject to / be subjected to
subject.q: 需要写一句仍适用的票务规则：“发车时间可能调整。”这里只说明可能性，不报告已经执行的处理。哪句准确？
o: Departure times were subjected to repeated adjustments yesterday.
Departure times are subject to change.
Departure times are subjected to a detailed inspection every morning.
Departure times are immune to change.

exp.trans: Departure times are subject to change：发车时间可能发生调整。
exp.structure: Departure times（主语）+ are（系动词）+ subject to change（表语）。这里是规则或可能状态，不是在叙述谁已经对时刻表做了什么处理。
exp.other: departure 出发；adjustment 调整；inspection 检查；be immune to 不受……影响。
exp.meaning: be subject to在这条规则中表示可能受变化影响。be subjected to通常强调某对象被施加了某个过程。
exp.rest: were subjected to repeated adjustments yesterday：报告昨天实际经历了反复调整，时态和事件性质均不符。are subjected to a detailed inspection：说每天被施加检查过程，inspection也不是时间可能调整。are immune to change：表示不受变化影响，与题意相反。

subject.target: be subject to / 实际事件
subject.skill: be subject to / be subjected to
subject.q: The mountain road is subject to closure during heavy snow. No closure has been announced today. Which report preserves both statements?
o: The road is reported closed after today's heavy snowfall.
Snow may close the road; no closure is reported today.
The road underwent a test involving closure earlier today.
The road is open because snow cannot lead to its closure.

exp.trans: 这条山路在大雪期间可能封闭。今天尚未宣布封路。准确报道是：大雪可能带来封路，但这两句没有报道今天已经封路。
exp.structure: The mountain road是主语，is是系动词，subject to closure表达所受约束或可能状态。第二句No closure是主语，has been announced是现在完成时被动谓语；没有公告不等于已验证现场一定开放。
exp.other: mountain road 山路；closure 封闭；announce 宣布；status 状态。
exp.meaning: be subject to可表示有可能受某变化影响，不自动表示该事件已经发生。这里也不能从“尚无公告”推出现场已确认开放。
exp.rest: 原文只报告可能受封闭影响，没有报告今天已封路；封路测试是虚构事件；未公布封路不等于已确认开放，更不能说大雪不会造成封路。

subject.skill: 避免把可能风险扩大成已经发生的事实
subject.q: A mountain road report says heavy snow can lead to closures, but today's bulletin only forecasts snow. Which conclusion is supported?
o: The road is closed today because heavy snow is forecast.
The forecast identifies a risk, not a confirmed closure today.
The road has remained open through every previous snowstorm.
The report proves that snow will not affect road access today.

exp.trans: 山区道路报告说，大雪可能导致封路，但今天的公告只是在预报降雪。最有根据的结论是：预报指出一种风险，并没有确认今天已经封路。
exp.structure: can lead to closures表达可能结果；today's bulletin only forecasts snow限制了当前已知事实。题干要求判断能得出什么结论，而不是推断可能后果已经发生。
exp.other: forecast 预报；closure 封路；confirmed 已确认的；road access 道路通行。
exp.meaning: 不能把条件性风险升级为已发生事件。可能导致封路，不等于今天已经封路；同样也不能反向断言降雪一定不会影响通行。
exp.rest: 预报降雪不等于已经封路；没有证据说明道路经历过所有以往的雪暴；报告指出风险，并没有证明雪不会影响通行。

summary-location.q: A paragraph begins: “Overall, the first phase cut waiting times but raised operating costs.” The article then spends two more paragraphs discussing why costs rose. What does Overall most likely do here?
o: It announces the final conclusion of the entire article.
It sums up the first phase before further cost analysis.
It introduces an example unrelated to the first phase.
It signals doubt about the first phase's reported results.

exp.trans: 段落开头说：“总体来看，第一阶段缩短了等待时间，但提高了运营成本。”随后文章又用两段分析成本为何上升。这里 Overall 最可能是在进一步分析之前概括第一阶段的总体结果。
exp.structure: 引号内主干：the first phase（主语）+ cut / raised（并列谓语）+ waiting times / operating costs（宾语）。Overall修饰整句判断，表示概括性评价；后文仍可继续展开。
exp.other: phase 阶段；waiting time 等待时间；operating cost 运营成本；further analysis 进一步分析。
exp.meaning: Overall是句子/段落层面的总结副词，表示“总体而言”；它不等于“全文到此结束”。
exp.rest: 后文还要分析成本，不能判为全文终结；这句话概括第一阶段而非引入无关例子；Overall本身不表示对结果存疑。

summary-location.target: 局部总结 / 段尾钩子
summary-location.q: A paragraph says: “Taken together, the short trials show that the sensor detects small leaks. That finding raises a further question: can it operate for weeks without a battery change?” Which next paragraph would best develop the hook?
o: A report of a month-long run and its power use.
A repetition of the first trial’s one-hour detection rate.
A history of the material used in the first sensor.
A claim that accurate detection already proves long battery life.

exp.trans: 一段写道：“短期试验合起来表明传感器能检测到小泄漏。这个发现引出进一步的问题：不换电池，它能否运行数周？”最能展开段尾钩子的是长达一个月的运行和耗电报告。
exp.structure: Taken together概括short trials；the sensor + detects + small leaks是that宾语从句。That finding回指检测结果。can it operate...?的问题将检测能力推进到长期供电能力。
exp.other: trial 试验；leak 泄漏；operate 运转；power use 耗电量。
exp.meaning: 局部总结不是全文封口。选下一段要回应新的运行时长问题，而非机械重复已总结的检测准确性。
exp.rest: one-hour detection rate只重复旧测试，未回答数周运行；material history转去材料背景，未接耗电问题；accurate detection proves long battery life把检测能力当成续航证据，两项指标不能自动互证。

relative.q:
The archive contains several letters. The historian based her argument on those letters.
最自然的合并是：
o: The archive contains several letters on which the historian based her argument.
The archive contains several letters which on the historian based her argument.
The archive contains several letters on that the historian based her argument.
The archive contains several letters which the historian based her argument on them.

diag.1: 介词 on 应放在关系代词 which 前，不能写 which on the historian...
diag.2: 介词后不能用关系代词 that；应使用 which。
diag.3: which 已经代替 those letters，后面再用 them 造成重复。

exp.trans: 这个档案馆收藏着几封信，历史学家正是依据这些信件提出了她的论证。
exp.structure: 原始简单句：The historian based her argument on those letters. → those letters 变成先行词 several letters，并用 which 代替：the letters which the historian based her argument on → 正式写法把介词前置：the letters on which the historian based her argument。
exp.other: archive 档案馆；historian 历史学家；base A on B 以B为依据建立A；argument 论证/观点。
exp.meaning: 介词 + which 用于物；介词来自原简单句中的搭配 base A on B。
exp.rest: 介词前置的正确句是 “letters on which ...”；把 which 放在 on 前、把 that 放在介词后，或在 which 后再保留 them，都会造成词序或关系词重复问题。

belief-negation-clause.target: assume that ... did not / 被批评的信念
belief-negation-clause.q: A restaurant owner rebuked an apprentice for assuming that the online booking page did not influence walk-in customers. Surveys showed that many visitors discovered the restaurant through the page. What did the apprentice mistakenly believe?
o: The owner had avoided creating an online booking page.
Walk-in customers were unaffected by the booking page.
Customers preferred online orders to meals at the restaurant.
The owner placed excessive importance on online advertising.

exp.trans: 老板批评学徒，因为学徒以为网上订位页面不影响未经预约直接到店的人；调查却显示不少访客就是经此页面了解餐厅。
exp.structure: rebuked an apprentice为主干，for assuming that...说明批评原因，that后的did not influence是学徒持有的错误判断。
exp.other: rebuke 责备；apprentice 学徒；walk-in customer 无预约上门顾客；reservation 预约。
exp.meaning: assume/imagine that表示以为、认为；否定词位于从句中，决定被批评的是低估作用而非对网络的痴迷。
exp.rest: 老板未建网页和顾客点餐偏好均无证据；把老板说成过分重视广告，也没有回答学徒错误地否认网页对临时到店顾客的影响。

parallel-governance.q: Which sentence has a clean parallel structure in which the same modal verb governs both alternatives?
o: The technician can either replace the sensor or recalibrate the device.
The technician either can replace the sensor or recalibration of the device.
The technician can either replacing the sensor or recalibrate the device.
The technician can either replace the sensor or the device is recalibrated.

exp.trans: 正确句：技术员可以要么更换传感器，要么重新校准设备。
exp.structure: 主干：The technician（主语）+ can（情态动词）+ either replace... or recalibrate...。can同时支配replace和recalibrate，两边都是动词原形，结构完全平行。
exp.other: technician 技术员；sensor 传感器；recalibrate 重新校准；device 设备。
exp.meaning: 共同动词支配时，并列两端应保持同一语法层级。这里 can + replace / recalibrate。
exp.rest: either can replace... or recalibration... 把动词结构和名词结构并列；can either replacing... 中情态动词后不能接-ing形式；replace... or the device is recalibrated 把动词短语和完整从句并列，层级不一致。

parallel-governance.target: 共同动词支配 / 并列任务
parallel-governance.q: The inspector recommended replacing the worn belt and checking the tension before restarting the machine. Which reading preserves the recommendation?
o: The inspector reported that both jobs had already been completed.
Replacing the belt was expected to check the tension automatically.
The inspector recommended two tasks: belt replacement and a tension check.
The machine should be restarted before either task is attempted.

exp.trans: 检查员建议在重新启动机器之前更换磨损的皮带并检查张力。建议包含两项任务：更换皮带和检查张力，而不是报告它们已经完成。
exp.structure: The inspector是主语，recommended是谓语。replacing the worn belt与checking the tension是并列动名词短语，共同作recommended的补足内容；before restarting the machine给执行顺序。
exp.other: inspector 检查员；worn belt 磨损的皮带；tension 张力；restart 重新启动。
exp.meaning: and把两项动作放在同一层级，都受recommended支配。后一个动名词不是第一个动作自动产生的效果，也不是新的已完成事实。
exp.rest: had already been completed把建议改成过去已完成事实；check ... automatically把两项独立任务合成一项的自动效果；restarted before either task反转before给出的执行顺序。

action-collocation.q: During a field inspection, a technician fastened a thin cord around the sensor housing by making a knot. The team then handed a calibration weight from one person to the next. Which pair describes the actions?
o: wrapped the cord / carried the weight
tied the cord / passed the weight
passed the cord / tied the weight
lit the cord / wrapped the weight

exp.trans: 现场检查时，技术员打结把细绳系在传感器外壳上；随后团队成员把校准砝码从一人手中传到下一人手中。对应动作是tie和pass。
exp.structure: 第一句technician fastened...by making a knot，by短语明确系绳方式是打结；第二句the team handed...from one person to the next，明确物体在人与人之间转交。
exp.other: field inspection现场检查；sensor housing传感器外壳；calibration weight校准砝码；knot结。
exp.meaning: tie表示系住、打结；pass something from one person to the next表示把东西传递给下一个人。要识别动作的结果和路径。
exp.rest: wrap表示包裹或缠绕，未必形成固定的结；carry表示携带而非交到下一人手中；pass the cord / tie the weight把两个动作对象对调；light和wrap都不符合句中动作。

action-collocation.q: At a camp safety drill, one camper handed a lantern from the first person to the last; another lit a stove after the group had settled. Which pair describes the actions?
o: lit the lantern / passed the stove
passed the lantern / lit the stove
wrapped the lantern / tied the stove
tied the lantern / wrapped the stove

exp.trans: 营地安全演练中，一名露营者把灯笼从队伍第一个人传到最后一个人；另一人等大家安顿后点燃了炉子。动作分别是传递灯笼和点燃炉子。
exp.structure: one camper handed a lantern...是第一项动作；from the first person to the last给出传递路径。another lit a stove是第二项动作，after从句说明时间。
exp.other: camp safety drill营地安全演练；lantern灯笼；stove炉子；settle安顿下来。
exp.meaning: pass表示把物品从一个人交给另一个人；light表示点燃。要把动词与其实际宾语及动作路径配对。
exp.rest: 把lit和passed的对象对调；wrap和tie表示包裹/系绑，不符合手递手传灯笼或点燃炉子的动作。

text4-executive-overreach.skill: 区分行政部门的权力主张与作者认可的结论
text4-executive-overreach.q: An executive agency says it can invalidate any otherwise lawful regional rule whenever the rule conflicts with its enforcement priorities. What does that claim imply?
o: It claims its enforcement power outweighs regional governments' authority.
Regional governments may override national laws whenever they disagree.
The legislature expressly banned all regional enforcement activity.
The agency accepts regional rules despite differences in enforcement priorities.

exp.trans: 一个行政机构声称，只要原本合法的地区规则与其执法优先事项冲突，它就可以使该规则失效。这相当于声称行政机构的执法权高于地区政府的权限。
exp.structure: An executive agency says that...引出机构的主张；whenever引出触发条件；otherwise lawful表示该规则在其他方面原本合法。
exp.other: executive agency 行政机构；invalidate 使……失效；otherwise lawful 原本合法的；enforcement priorities 执法优先事项；authority 权限。
exp.meaning: 题目问what does that claim imply，应概括机构声称自己拥有多大权限，而不是把这一主张误当成作者认可的法律结论。
exp.rest: 地区政府可以随意推翻国家法律是把权力方向反过来；立法机关明文禁止所有地区执法并未在句中出现；最后一项与机构声称可使冲突规则失效相反。

text4-executive-overreach.target: executive enforcement choice vs statutory local authority
text4-executive-overreach.skill: 行政不执行是否能取消地方依法获授的权力
text4-executive-overreach.q: A national agency declined to inspect licensed buses, then claimed towns could not carry out inspections that a statute authorized them to do. The court rejected the claim. What principle does its decision illustrate?
o: The agency may suspend towns' lawful inspections by choosing not to act.
The court rejected an attempt to block towns from exercising powers granted by law.
The towns were newly authorized to rewrite national transport standards.
The court found that national agencies alone may set all inspection dates.

exp.trans: 国家行政机构不愿检查已获许可的公交车，随后却声称法律已授权的市镇检查也不能执行。法院驳回该主张，说明行政机关自身选择不执法，不能自动取消地方依法获授的权限。
exp.structure: declined... then claimed...区分行政机关自身行为与扩张主张；a statute authorized them to do修饰inspections；The court rejected the claim给出司法回应。
exp.other: agency 行政机构；statute 成文法；authorize 授权；suspend 暂停；licensed bus 已获许可的公交车辆。
exp.meaning: 行政机关不执行某项政策与禁止地方执行是两个命题。这里法院限制的是行政部门把其执行偏好扩展成否定地方合法权限的企图。
exp.rest: 行政不作为并未赋予机构暂停合法地方执法的权力；法院未授权市镇重写国家标准；设定检查日期也不是法院本次驳回的争点。

text4-executive-overreach.target: claim about enforcement power vs legal authority
text4-executive-overreach.skill: 区分行政部门的主张与作者认可的结论
text4-executive-overreach.q: An executive agency claims it can invalidate any otherwise lawful regional rule whenever that rule conflicts with the agency's enforcement priorities. What does the agency's claim amount to?
o: Regional governments can override national laws they oppose.
Its enforcement priorities can override lawful regional rules.
The legislature prohibited regional agencies from enforcing rules.
Regional rules remain valid despite different enforcement priorities.

exp.trans: 一个行政机构声称，只要某项原本合法的地区规则与该机构的执法优先事项冲突，它就可以使该规则失效。这相当于声称，该机构的执法权高于地区政府所拥有的权限。
exp.structure: claims后面是机构主张的内容；whenever引出触发条件；otherwise lawful表示该规则在其他方面原本合法。
exp.other: invalidate 使……失效；otherwise lawful 原本合法的；enforcement priorities 执法优先事项；outweigh 权重或重要性高于。
exp.meaning: 要区分被描述的主张与文章作者认可的结论。句子是在复述行政机构想要的权力范围，并不代表作者认为这种主张正确。
exp.rest: 地区推翻国家法律反转了主张中的权力方向；立法机关禁止地方执法没有文本依据；机构声称可使规则失效，并非承认优先事项不同时规则仍有效。
